params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever {{ci|Jinx}} scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, {{tip|turret}}, or [[inhibitor]] shortly after damaging them, she gains a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: During this time, she also gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus total''' attack speed}}}} and is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Jinx''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, {{tip|turret}}, or [[inhibitor]] within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|175% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 6 seconds.
params.description2: Additionally, she is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}} and gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Get Excited!'' for the same duration, stacking up to 5 times. Only {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can grant stacks beyond the first.
params.description3: {{sbc|Get Excited!:}} For each stack, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|{{as|25% '''total''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{ap|25*5}}%|as}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Whenever Jinx scores a takedown against an enemy champion, epic monster, turret, or inhibitor shortly after damaging them, she gains a burst of movement speed for a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: During this time, she also gains bonus total attack speed and is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap.

description.plain: Innate: Whenever Jinx scores a takedown against an enemy champion, epic monster, turret, or inhibitor within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains 175% bonus movement speed decaying over 6 seconds.

description2.plain: Additionally, she is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap and gains a stack of Get Excited! for the same duration, stacking up to 5 times. Only takedowns against enemy champions can grant stacks beyond the first.

description3.plain: Get Excited!: For each stack, Jinx gains 25% total attack speed, up to a maximum of 125%.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Toggle:}} {{ci|Jinx}} switches between Pow-Pow, her minigun, and Fishbones, her rocket launcher.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|{{cci|Pow-Pow.png|Jinx#Pow-Pow|Pow-Pow}}:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} with '''Pow-Pow''' generate {{tip|stacks}} of [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] ''Rev'd up'' for a short time. Stacks expire one at a time.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|{{cci|Fishbones.png|Jinx#Fishbones|Fishbones}}:}} Basic attacks with '''Fishbones''' {{sti|mana|{{as|cost mana}}}} to deal {{as|increased physical damage}} to the primary target as well as surrounding enemies. While using '''Fishbones''', ''Jinx'' gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} but loses a portion of her {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Rev'd up:}} For each stack, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, with the first stack being twice as potent. Only the first attack after switching to '''Fishbones''' will benefit from ''Rev'd up''.
params.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Jinx''' switches between ''{{cci|Pow-Pow.png|Jinx#Pow-Pow|Pow-Pow}}'', her minigun, and ''{{cci|Fishbones.png|Jinx#Fishbones|Fishbones}}'', her rocket launcher.
params.description2: {{sbc|Pow-Pow:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} with ''Pow-Pow'' generate a {{tip|stack}} of [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] ''Rev'd up'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with ''Pow-Pow'' and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of ''Rev'd up'' grants {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.
params.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30/2 to 130/2}}%|Attack Speed per Subsequent Stack|{{ap|30/4 to 130/4}}%|Maximum Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 130}}%}}
params.description3: {{sbc|Fishbones:}} Basic attacks with ''Fishbones'' cost {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|110% AD}} {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers. While ''Fishbones'' is equipped, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} but loses {{sti|{{as|10% of her '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.description4: ''Only the first attack after switching to [[File:Switcheroo!.png|20px|link=]] Fishbones will benefit from [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] Rev'd up''.

blurb.plain: Toggle: Jinx switches between Pow-Pow, her minigun, and Fishbones, her rocket launcher.

blurb2.plain: ⟦cci⟧: Basic attacks with Pow-Pow generate stacks of Rev'd up for a short time. Stacks expire one at a time.

blurb3.plain: ⟦cci⟧: Basic attacks with Fishbones cost mana to deal increased physical damage to the primary target as well as surrounding enemies. While using Fishbones, Jinx gains bonus range but loses a portion of her bonus attack speed.

blurb4.plain: Rev'd up: For each stack, Jinx gains bonus attack speed, with the first stack being twice as potent. Only the first attack after switching to Fishbones will benefit from Rev'd up.

description.plain: Toggle: Jinx switches between ⟦cci⟧, her minigun, and ⟦cci⟧, her rocket launcher.

description2.plain: Pow-Pow: Basic attacks with Pow-Pow generate a stack of Rev'd up for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with Pow-Pow and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of Rev'd up grants bonus attack speed, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.

description3.plain: Fishbones: Basic attacks with Fishbones cost mana on-attack to deal 110% AD modified physical damage to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by critical strike modifiers. While Fishbones is equipped, Jinx gains bonus range but loses 10% of her bonus attack speed.

description4.plain: Only the first attack after switching to Fishbones will benefit from Rev'd up.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jinx}} fires a shock bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' fires a shock blast in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy it hits and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
params.cast time: {{pp|0.6 to 0.4 for 11|0 to 250|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|color=attack speed}}

blurb.plain: Active: Jinx fires a shock bolt in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing them for a short time.

description.plain: Active: Jinx fires a shock blast in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy it hits and reveals and slows them for 2 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jinx}} tosses a line of ''Chompers'' at the target location that explode after a few seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: If an enemy champion steps on a ''Chomper'', it will explode, {{tip|knockdown|knock them down}}, and briefly {{tip|root}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description2: Each ''Chomper'' explodes on contact with an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.
params.notes:
* ''Chompers'' will halt when encountering {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not negate the explosion.
* Each ''Chomper'' gives vision of its surrounding area.

blurb.plain: Active: Jinx tosses a line of Chompers at the target location that explode after a few seconds, dealing magic damage.

blurb2.plain: If an enemy champion steps on a Chomper, it will explode, knock them down, and briefly root them.

description.plain: Active: Jinx tosses out 3 Chompers centered at the target location, landing after 0.4 seconds, arming after 0.5 seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal magic damage to nearby enemies.

description2.plain: Each Chomper explodes on contact with an enemy champion, knocking them down and rooting them for 1.5 seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one Chomper.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jinx}} fires a rocket in the target direction that explodes upon the first enemy champion hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies.
params.blurb2: The damage is increased based on travel time and each {{as|target's missing health}}. Surrounding enemies take reduced damage.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jinx''' fires a massive rocket in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight into brush nor through terrain}} and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion. The explosion deals {{as|physical damage}} to {{tt|nearby|centered on the initial target}} enemies and grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can grant sight into brush and through terrain}} for 2 seconds.
params.description2: ''Super Mega Death Rocket!'' deals {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|10 to 100 for 16|0 to 1500}} damage. This does not affect the '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
params.leveling2: {{st|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
params.description3: Enemies surrounding the primary target take 80% damage. The '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}} is capped at 1200 against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling3: {{st|Maximum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Minimum Secondary Damage|{{ap|(200 to 500)*0.8*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.8*0.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25 to 35)*0.8}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|1700|Initial missile speed}}|{{tt|2200|Increased missile speed after travelling over 1350 units}}}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|400|Explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|1000|Missile sight radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|1000|Explosion sight radius}}}}
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the explosion.
* ''Super Mega Death Rocket's'' projectile has an [[File:Super Mega Death Rocket! Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Jinx''' and her allies.
* The bonus damage based on missing health is based on each unit's own missing health and not the primary target's.
* Unlike similar spells, ''Super Mega Death Rocket'' will not increase it's damage when ranked up while the missile is in flight.{{bug|2}}
** This is because the base damage is fixed at a multiple of the damage the rocket initially started with.
** The {{as|'''bonus''' AD}} ratio will still update when {{as|AD}} is gained or lost between the cast and hit of the missile.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
params.tips: * The maximum damage is reached after traveling 1500 units, which is exactly equal to the range of her {{ai|Zap!|Jinx}}, or roughly {{fd|0.85}} seconds of travel time. The rocket changes its visual appearance and missile speed slightly earlier, after traveling 1350 units.

blurb.plain: Active: Jinx fires a rocket in the target direction that explodes upon the first enemy champion hit, dealing physical damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

blurb2.plain: The damage is increased based on travel time and each target's missing health. Surrounding enemies take reduced damage.

description.plain: Active: Jinx fires a massive rocket in the target direction, briefly granting sight of its surroundings and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion. The explosion deals physical damage to nearby enemies and grants sight of the area for 2 seconds.

description2.plain: Super Mega Death Rocket! deals 10% – 100% (based on distance traveled) damage. This does not affect the bonus damage based on the target's missing health.

description3.plain: Enemies surrounding the primary target take 80% damage. The bonus damage based on the target's missing health is capped at 1200 against monsters.
